events.title: OpenAI describes a production factory for performance investigations
events.title_zh: OpenAI 公开性能调查自动化工厂的生产经验
events.summary: OpenAI described an internal agent system that turns performance regressions into tracked investigations, dispatches Codex cloud sessions and routes proposed root causes through human review. Over three months it ran more than 1,700 investigations and identified more than 600 root causes. A manual review of 100 suggestions judged 70% accurate; the system and measurements are not public.
events.summary_en: OpenAI described an internal agent system that turns performance regressions into tracked investigations, dispatches Codex cloud sessions and routes proposed root causes through human review. Over three months it ran more than 1,700 investigations and identified more than 600 root causes. A manual review of 100 suggestions judged 70% accurate; the system and measurements are not public.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 公开了一套内部 agent 系统：它把性能回退转成可追踪调查，调度 Codex 云端会话，再由人审核根因建议。三个月内系统运行了 1,700 多次调查，找出 600 多个根因。人工抽查 100 条建议后，70% 被判定准确；系统与测量数据未公开。
events.why_it_matters: For teams operating large codebases, the useful pattern is the combination of durable task state, scoped service identities, event-driven dispatch and human merge authority. The article is an internal case study, not a reusable release or independent evaluation.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams operating large codebases, the useful pattern is the combination of durable task state, scoped service identities, event-driven dispatch and human merge authority. The article is an internal case study, not a reusable release or independent evaluation.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对维护大型代码库的团队来说，可借鉴的是持久任务状态、受限服务身份、事件驱动调度与人工合并权限的组合。它仍是内部案例，不是可直接部署的产品，也没有独立评测。

technical_details.deployment: Internal production system; no public code or API
technical_details.reported_scale: More than 1,700 investigations and 600 root causes in three months; about 17 investigations per day
technical_details.manual_review: 100 root-cause suggestions reviewed; 70% judged accurate and 30% needed refinement or were not causal
technical_details.control_boundary: Scoped service identity; humans decide what ships; a separate reviewer agent challenges conclusions
technical_details.evidence_limit: Publisher case study; workload, sampling and full error distribution are not public
technical_details.time_basis: Official post published 2026-11-19T08:00:00Z; found outside the overlap during directed gap review

technical_details_zh.部署: 内部生产系统；没有公开代码或 API
technical_details_zh.发布方规模: 三个月运行 1,700 多次调查并找出 600 多个根因；平均每天约 17 次调查
technical_details_zh.人工抽查: 抽查 100 条根因建议；70% 被判准确，30% 需要修改或不构成因果
technical_details_zh.控制边界: 使用受限服务身份；由人决定是否上线；另设 reviewer agent 反驳结论
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 发布方内部案例；工作负载、抽样方式与完整错误分布未公开
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 官方文章发布于 2026-11-19T08:00:00Z；早于 overlap，由定向补漏发现

events.next_action_zh: 等待公开实现或可复现的独立案例，再评估是否把该模式引入生产性能调查。
events.next_action_en: Wait for a public implementation or reproducible independent case before adopting the pattern for production performance investigations.

evidence.claim_en: OpenAI’s article confirms the system design, internal operating scale and review of 100 suggestions.
evidence.verification: verified-primary-source; internal metrics not independently reproduced

events.title: OpenAI releases GPT-Live-1.1 with lower-cost standby sessions
events.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-Live-1.1 与低价待机模式
events.summary: OpenAI made GPT-Live-1.1 callable through the Live API. OpenAI reports better multilingual transcription and more consistent accents than GPT-Live-1, without publishing an independent benchmark. Active sessions cost $0.05 per minute; WebRTC sessions can pause inference at a $0.02 standby rate.
events.summary_en: OpenAI made GPT-Live-1.1 callable through the Live API. OpenAI reports better multilingual transcription and more consistent accents than GPT-Live-1, without publishing an independent benchmark. Active sessions cost $0.05 per minute; WebRTC sessions can pause inference at a $0.02 standby rate.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 已通过 Live API 开放 GPT-Live-1.1。官方称其多语言转写与跨语言口音一致性优于 GPT-Live-1，但没有公开独立 benchmark。活跃会话为每分钟 0.05 美元，WebRTC 暂停推理时可按每分钟 0.02 美元待机。
events.why_it_matters: Voice-agent teams can keep WebRTC sessions alive during silence at a lower rate, but should verify wake latency, transcription quality and separate backend charges before migrating.
events.why_it_matters_en: Voice-agent teams can keep WebRTC sessions alive during silence at a lower rate, but should verify wake latency, transcription quality and separate backend charges before migrating.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对语音 agent 团队来说，静默期无需断开 WebRTC 会话即可降低费用；迁移前仍要验证唤醒延迟、多语言转写和另计的后端调用费用。

technical_details.standby_limit: WebRTC only while inference is paused
technical_details.benchmark_boundary: Quality gains are vendor-reported without a public benchmark
technical_details.time_basis: Official changelog provides 2026-11-19 without a publication hour.

technical_details_zh.待机限制: 仅限 WebRTC 且推理暂停期间
technical_details_zh.评测边界: 质量提升来自厂商陈述，没有公开 benchmark
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 官方 changelog 只提供 2026-11-19，没有发布时间。

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用 20 段多语言通话比较 GPT-Live-1 与 1.1 的转写、口音、待机唤醒延迟和总成本。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, compare GPT-Live-1 and 1.1 on 20 multilingual calls for transcription, accent, standby wake latency and total cost.

evidence.claim_zh: OpenAI 文档确认 GPT-Live-1.1 已可调用，并列出活跃与待机价格。
evidence.claim_en: OpenAI documentation confirms GPT-Live-1.1 availability and active and standby prices.
evidence.verification: verified official API availability and pricing

changes.summary_zh: GPT-Live-1.1 开放 API，并为 WebRTC 静默期加入低价待机。
changes.summary_en: GPT-Live-1.1 becomes available through the API with lower-cost WebRTC standby.

events.title: InclusionAI opens LingSante-3.1-flash weights for medical agent research
events.title_zh: InclusionAI 开放 LingSante-3.1-flash 医疗 agent 权重
events.summary: InclusionAI released MIT-licensed LingSante-3.1-flash weights for medical reasoning, evidence research and long-horizon healthcare workflows. The 560B-total, 25B-active MoE inherits Ling-3.1-flash and includes public SGLang and vLLM recipes. The publisher limits it to research and evaluation rather than independent diagnosis or treatment.
events.summary_en: InclusionAI released MIT-licensed LingSante-3.1-flash weights for medical reasoning, evidence research and long-horizon healthcare workflows. The 560B-total, 25B-active MoE inherits Ling-3.1-flash and includes public SGLang and vLLM recipes. The publisher limits it to research and evaluation rather than independent diagnosis or treatment.
events.summary_zh: InclusionAI 公开 LingSante-3.1-flash 的 MIT 权重，面向医疗推理、证据研究与长流程医疗任务。该 MoE 总参数 560B、每 token 激活 25B，沿用 Ling-3.1-flash 并提供 SGLang 与 vLLM 配方。发布方明确限定为研究与评估用途，不能独立用于诊断或治疗。
events.why_it_matters: For teams evaluating healthcare RAG or medical agents, this is a deployable open-weight candidate with tool-use recipes, but not clinical validation. Publisher benchmarks and simulated workflows do not establish effectiveness across institutions, populations or live care.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams evaluating healthcare RAG or medical agents, this is a deployable open-weight candidate with tool-use recipes, but not clinical validation. Publisher benchmarks and simulated workflows do not establish effectiveness across institutions, populations or live care.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对评估医疗 RAG 或医疗 agent 的团队来说，这是带工具调用配方的可部署开放权重候选，但不等于临床验证。厂商 benchmark 与模拟流程不能证明它能跨机构、人群或真实诊疗场景稳定工作。

technical_details.architecture: Hybrid-linear MoE; 560B total and 25B active parameters
technical_details.access: MIT weights on Hugging Face; API link and SGLang/vLLM recipes are public

events.title: Google adds on-demand Tool Retrieval to the Gemini API
events.title_zh: Google 为 Gemini API 加入按需 Tool Retrieval
events.summary: Google launched Tool Retrieval in preview in the Gemini Interactions API. Agents can defer full tool schemas, load them on demand inside a request, and use the same mechanism with remote MCP servers. It works with Gemini 3.6 and later and has no separate fee beyond model tokens.
events.summary_en: Google launched Tool Retrieval in preview in the Gemini Interactions API. Agents can defer full tool schemas, load them on demand inside a request, and use the same mechanism with remote MCP servers. It works with Gemini 3.6 and later and has no separate fee beyond model tokens.
events.summary_zh: Google 在 Gemini Interactions API 推出 preview 版 Tool Retrieval。Agent 可以延后加载完整工具 schema，在单次请求中按需取回；远程 MCP server 也可使用同一机制。它支持 Gemini 3.6 及后续模型，不单独收费，只按模型 token 计费。
events.why_it_matters: Large-tool agents can reduce prompt bloat without running their own schema index, but teams still need to measure selection accuracy, authorization and latency on their actual tool catalog.
events.why_it_matters_en: Large-tool agents can reduce prompt bloat without running their own schema index, but teams still need to measure selection accuracy, authorization and latency on their actual tool catalog.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对连接大量工具的 agent 来说，可以减少 prompt 中的 schema 膨胀，也不用自建索引；但真实工具库的选择准确率、授权和延迟仍需验证。

technical_details.mechanism: tool_search plus defer_loading; server-side or client-side retrieval
technical_details.mcp: Remote MCP server tools can be loaded on demand
technical_details.pricing: No separate charge; standard model token billing
technical_details.time_basis: Official blog and page metadata give 2026-11-19T18:00:00Z; recovered as an older omission

technical_details_zh.模型: Gemini 3.6 及后续模型，包括 Gemini 4
technical_details_zh.价格: 无单独费用，按模型 token 标准计费
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 官方博客和页面元数据为 2026-11-19T18:00:00Z；本轮作为旧遗漏补录

events.next_action_en: Within one day, compare full schemas with deferred loading across 50 permission-varied tools for tokens, latency, misselection and unauthorized calls.
